title: External warehouse location projection
description: Warehouse-location registry whitelist without source, evidence, audit, or internal fields.

location_type.description: Optional and NOT emitted by v1 (OD-C24-02, owner decision 05-09-2026). No approved taxonomy and no source column exist on the provider side. Consumers MUST NOT infer it from location_code, location_name or warehouse type, and MUST NOT treat its absence as a defect. Populating it requires an approved vocabulary plus a data-steward backfill in a successor contract.
